results.title: Senior Operations Manager – Contract Logistics & Warehousing
results.description: We are supporting a leading 3PL and contract logistics business in the UAE with the appointment of a Senior Operations Manager to lead a complex, high-volume warehousing operation in Dubai. The successful candidate will take ownership of operational performance across warehousing, inventory, customer SLAs, productivity, cost control and continuous improvement, while leading and developing a sizeable operations team. Key responsibilities include: Lead day-to-day warehouse and contract logistics operations Deliver agreed customer SLAs, KPIs and service levels Drive warehouse productivity, capacity utilisation and operational efficiency Maintain high levels of inventory accuracy and stock integrity Manage operational budgets, labour costs and indirect expenditure Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives Ensure effective utilisation of WMS and operational reporting systems Lead, coach and develop warehouse operations teams Work closely with customer service, transport and commercial teams Maintain strong standards across HSSE, compliance and operational procedures Candidate profile: 8+ years’ experience within 3PL, contract logistics or large-scale warehousing Proven experience leading complex warehouse operations and sizeable teamsPrevious experience leading warehouse operations and sizeable teams Strong understanding of WMS, inventory control and warehouse KPIs Demonstrable experience managing customer SLAs and operational performance Commercial understanding of warehouse costs, productivity and resource planning Strong continuous improvement and problem-solving capability UAE/GCC logistics experience would be advantageous This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced logistics professional looking to take ownership of a complex, customer-focused operation in Dubai.

results.title: Manager - Vehicle Operations
results.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
results.description: We operate an autonomous delivery fleet in Abu Dhabi. This role owns the frontline team that keeps the fleet running — several hundred people, growing fast. The work spans remote monitoring of vehicles in service and on-road support in the field, run as one cross-trained team on a single roster. You own the machine that grows and runs it: the sourcing pipeline and manpower suppliers, the training and certification line, the roster, the quality bar, and the supervisors who run shifts once you can no longer be in every room. The operation is live seven days a week and the safety and quality floor does not move. What You'll Own The ramp — sourcing pipeline, manpower suppliers, hiring bar, onboarding throughput and attrition, plus the training and certification line that pushes that volume through without diluting the standard. Operator productivity, attendance and working-hour utilisation — and what has to change for those numbers to move. The management layer — the supervisors you recruit and promote, and the layered QA that tells you how a shift went when you weren't on it. Workforce operations at scale — visas, accommodation, transport, rostering compliance, and the allocation of field resources across competing demands. What You'll Need A frontline of several hundred, run full cycle — recruitment, training, rostering, performance, attrition. Not a contract population you coordinated with, but people you were accountable for and managed through supervisors. A ramp you personally delivered — took a team to several times its size, or mobilised a new site, centre or contract from nothing, with the numbers and the timeline to show it. Seated, real-time operations — control rooms, contact and service centres, command and dispatch centres, or autonomous-vehicle operations: people at consoles working live tasks against a response-time and quality standard. Dispersed field labour is a different job. A training and QA standard you built yourself — designed the assessment, set the pass bar, and made it hold across shifts. Running someone else's system is a different job. Strong English as a working language — you hire, train, appraise and resolve conflict directly with an Indian, Pakistani, Filipino and Ugandan frontline. A valid driving licence. Based in Abu Dhabi or ready to relocate. Strongly Preferred AV safety operator teams UAE blue-collar workforce operations — MOHRE, visas, accommodation, manpower suppliers 24/7 multi-shift operations Hindi, Urdu or Arabic What We Offer A UAE-benchmarked package, AI tools, visa sponsorship, and a non-rotating day shift. The Reality of the Job You would build the largest frontline team in Middle East autonomous delivery — several hundred people and growing fast, with the ramp, the standard and operator productivity all sitting with this one person. To be straight about the rest: the hiring and training pressure is relentless, and rostering and efficiency tooling is still incomplete — parts of the job run manually before they run on a system.

results.title: Sr. Manager Logistics Operations
results.description: Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. Job Description WHAT’S ON YOUR PLATE? Lead Talabat Qatar’s overall supply ecosystem, ensuring a sustainable, high-quality, and high-performing rider base across the country. Develop and execute the overall supply growth and acquisition strategy aligned with business demand and market dynamics. Lead long-term supply forecasting and planning to ensure full coverage and service level adherence. Identify and launch new supply channels such as female riders, refugees, micro-financing, and e-bikes to diversify and sustain fleet growth. Manage the full lifecycle of 3PL partnerships, from selection and onboarding to performance management and contract renewals. Set clear KPIs and SLAs for 3PL partners, ensuring compliance, efficiency, and rider quality. Build and maintain strong strategic relationships with key 3PL partners to drive alignment and operational excellence. Lead and manage the on-ground operations team to ensure smooth daily operations, compliance, and service quality. Monitor and improve key operational KPIs including rider supply rate, EPH, order-on-time percentage, and churn rate. Implement standardized processes and digital tools to enhance control, visibility, and scalability across operations. Coach and develop a high-performing team of managers, seniors, and specialists across supply, 3PLs, and operations. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team. Work closely with cross-functional teams such as People, Finance, Commercial, and Product to align on strategies and deliverables. Identify and implement process improvements and best practices to enhance efficiency and rider satisfaction. Drive automation and technology-enabled initiatives to improve visibility and performance management. Oversee equipment management including uniforms, delivery boxes, and e-bikes to ensure consistent quality and operational standards. Ensure adherence to performance KPIs such as supply run rate, rider churn and retention, 3PL compliance, rider NPS, EPH, and operational coverage. Build long-term plans to sustain growth and strengthen Talabat’s market leadership position. Qualifications WHAT DID WE ORDER? Bachelor’s degree required, with a preference for majors in Logistics, Supply Chain, Operations, or equivalent work experience in compliance or auditing Minimum of 5 years of experience in operational roles within fast-paced environments. Track record in the FoodTech logistics sector is a plus. Management consulting experience is also considered a significant advantage Management experience is advantageous, with the ability to effectively manage direct reports and foster a strong team culture. Strong problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to dig into detail, manage complexity, and drive decision-making Advanced proficiency in GSheet, demonstrating a strong analytical skill set. Ability to reason analytically, logically, and in a consistent fashion Strong English written and verbal communication skills, capable of engaging across a diverse set of stakeholders, Arabic is good to have but not necessary Extremely organized and process-driven, with a proven ability to manage a heavy workload effectively by setting priorities and managing expectations well Able to travel to all talabat markets as needed.

results.title: Operations Manager – Long-Term Rentals

The role will be responsible for coordinating and managing multiple teams, including Sales, Operations, Finance, Customer Service, and other supporting functions , ensuring that all departments work together effectively to achieve business objectives. The ideal candidate will be a strong people leader with excellent commercial and operational understanding, capable of driving performance, improving processes, and ensuring smooth day-to-day functioning of the LTR business. Key Responsibilities Oversee the overall performance and day-to-day functioning of the LTR business. Lead and coordinate teams across Sales, Operations, Finance, Customer Service, and other relevant functions. Set clear KPIs and ensure teams achieve their performance and business targets. Monitor revenue, costs, fleet utilisation, customer satisfaction, and overall operational efficiency. Work closely with department leads to identify issues, improve processes, and ensure smooth cross-functional coordination. Drive customer acquisition, retention, and overall service quality. Monitor financial and operational performance and identify opportunities for cost optimisation and revenue growth. Handle escalations and ensure timely resolution of cross-functional and customer-related issues. Prepare and present regular performance reports and updates to senior management. Lead, motivate, and develop teams while maintaining a strong culture of accountability and performance. Identify opportunities to improve processes, productivity, and overall business efficiency. Strong commercial and analytical mindset with the ability to understand business performance and KPIs. Experience in managing budgets, costs, revenue, and operational performance. results.title: Senior Specialist, Fleet Management
results.description: About Maaden JOB DESCRIPTION Maaden, established in 1997, is one of the fastest-growing mining companies in the world and the largest multi-commodity mining and metals company in the Middle East. We are leading the development of the mining industry to become the third pillar of Saudi Arabia’s economy by building a world-class, unique, and fully integrated mining value chain. We are pleased to share an exciting opportunity for the above-mentioned position. This role offers a chance to contribute to our ambitious growth and play a key part in shaping the future of mining in the Kingdom. Job Purpose The Senior Specialist, Fleet Management will manage and control fleet operations effectively by ensuring optimal vehicle utilization, safety compliance, cost control, and service reliability across field operations. The role supports uninterrupted transportation services through proactive maintenance planning, system management, vendor coordination, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement of fleet efficiency. Key Accountabilities Fleet Operations Oversight Oversee general fleet operations to ensure optimal vehicle availability, utilization, and efficiency. Supervise daily vehicle allocation, scheduling, and usage based on operational requirements. Maintenance & Safety Management Manage vehicle repair and maintenance activities, ensuring timely completion and quality standards. Plan, schedule, and monitor preventive maintenance programs for all fleet vehicles. Conduct regular in person vehicle inspections to verify roadworthiness and condition. Ensure full compliance with safety, legal, and regulatory requirements governing fleet operations. Reporting & Performance Analysis Maintain accurate daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual fleet reports. Prepare ad hoc reports and data analysis to support management decision making. Develop, implement, and monitor fleet KPIs such as downtime, cost per kilometer, fuel efficiency, and availability. Vendor & Contract Management Coordinate with fleet service providers and suppliers for vehicle maintenance, repairs, and related services. Review technical proposals and quotations for fleet related services and supplies. Review and validate fleet service and supply invoices for accuracy and compliance. Notify the Administration team in advance for timely renewal or extension of fleet contracts and purchase orders. Driver & Team Supervision Supervise drivers & JMS Team performance, including roster planning and policy compliance. Manage and oversee the JMS team, implementing corrective actions when required. Monitor and respond to Blue Key Users events such as seat belt violations or speeding and formally notify respective line managers for action. Trip & Pool Service Management Manage trip requests, including permanent vehicle assignments and pool service scheduling. Ensure efficient allocation, availability, and control of pool service vehicles. System & Documentation Management Ensure effective TAMM system management, including registering vehicles under the correct users. Maintain up to date vehicle documentation including registration, insurance, and compliance records. Fuel & Expense Control Monitor fuel consumption patterns, identify variances, and implement control measures. Manage driver petty cash, approve operational expenses, and ensure proper documentation and reconciliation. Spare Parts & Inventory Coordination Coordinate with the Inventory Team to ensure adequate availability of fleet related spare parts and consumables. Accident & Insurance Handling Manage accident-related processes including insurance claims, documentation, and repair follow up until vehicle closure and return to service. Financial Controls Review petty cash invoices (related to vehicles) and support documents before submission to Reporting Team. Administrative Support & Continuous Improvement Raise purchase requisitions for fleet related assets, items, and services and follow up until delivery. Drive initiatives to reduce fleet operating costs, improve efficiency, and enhance service performance. Perform any other duties assigned by management in support of fleet operations. Minimum Qualifications Minimum Qualification, Experience and Competencies Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Logistics, Transportation Management, or related discipline, or equivalent relevant fleet management experience. Minimum Experience Minimum 8–10 years of experience in fleet operations, transportation management, or related roles. Experience managing vehicles across multiple sites or remote operations is preferred. Hands on experience in fleet systems, maintenance coordination, and compliance management. Experience working in remote sites, camps, or industrial / mining environments is preferred. Proven experience with audits, reporting, and fleet management systems Maaden High Performance Competencies Achievement Drive Safety & Compliance Orientation Operational Excellence Analytical Thinking Planning & Organizing Accountability & Ownership Teamwork & Collaboration Leadership & People Management Communication Problem Solving & Decision Making Digital & System Orientation Continuous Improvement Mindset Integrity & Ethical Conduct Skills Strong knowledge of inventory systems, asset management, and supply chain workflows. Strong understanding of fleet operations, vehicle maintenance, and preventive maintenance planning. Ability to plan and coordinate transportation logistics across multiple locations. Vendor management, contract oversight, and invoice validation skills. Knowledge of safety, legal, and regulatory requirements for fleet operations. Analytical capability to optimize fleet utilization, monitor KPIs, and control fuel consumption. Proficiency in fleet management systems such as TAMM and JMS, with strong documentation control. Leadership and supervisory skills to manage drivers and fleet support teams. Ability to conduct inspections, audits, and enforce operational compliance. Effective problem solving and decision-making skills during incidents or emergencies. Strong organizational and time management abilities to handle multiple priorities. Familiarity with accident handling, insurance coordination, and cost control measures. Continuous improvement mindset focused on performance enhancement and cost reduction. Proficiency in preparing structured reports and analyzing operational data for management.

results.title: Executive Director – Logistics

The role will have broad responsibility for business strategy, commercial performance, operations, customer development and team leadership. Requirements: Bachelor's degree required; postgraduate qualification preferred. 15 years of experience in logistics, freight forwarding or a related industry. At least 5 years in a senior leadership role with significant commercial and P&L responsibility. Proven track record of building, transforming or scaling a logistics business. Strong commercial background with experience in business development, customer acquisition and strategic partnerships. Broad knowledge of freight and logistics operations, ideally across multiple modes and markets. Demonstrated ability to deliver revenue, profitability and growth targets. Experience leading and developing large, multicultural teams. Strong strategic thinking, commercial acumen and execution capability. Excellent negotiation, stakeholder management and communication skills. Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate effectively in a growth and transformation environment. Fluent English required; Arabic is an advantage. Key Responsibilities: Develop and execute the business strategy and growth plan for the logistics business. Lead commercial development across key markets, customers and industry sectors. Build and manage strategic relationships with customers, logistics partners, carriers and other key stakeholders. Drive revenue, profitability, customer growth and overall P&L performance. Develop and optimize logistics products and solutions across relevant modes and services. Establish efficient operational processes, service standards and performance KPIs. Identify new market, customer and partnership opportunities to accelerate growth. Lead the development of a high-performing organization, including recruitment, capability building and succession planning. Ensure strong governance across compliance, risk, quality, safety and operational performance. Drive the use of technology and digital solutions to improve efficiency and customer experience. Represent the organization with key customers, partners, regulators and industry stakeholders. Work closely with senior leadership and corporate functions to deliver strategic objectives.

results.title: Manager Logistics Performance
results.description: Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. Job Description Role Summary This role owns the commercial and performance engine behind talabat UAE's operations. You'll be the person who understands how the business actually ticks, where margin is made or lost, which levers move the numbers, and what trade-offs leadership is really weighing. You'll own the operational commercials and KPI performance, drive the optimization work that improves efficiency and experience, and turn analysis into decisions. It's a role for someone equally comfortable in a model and in a room full of directors, someone who can read the data and stand their ground on what it means . What's on your plate? Commercial & P&L Ownership for Operations Own the commercials behind UAE operations, cost-per-order, rider cost, and the efficiency metrics that drive the operational P&L. Track budget vs. actuals, protect riders and 3pls earnings, and give leadership clear, data-backed trade-offs between cost, growth, and customer experience. You're the person who can explain why the numbers moved, not just that they did. Performance Management Own the UAE operational KPI stack, from forecast to actuals. Anticipate performance gaps before they hit the P&L and drive the interventions that close them. Run the reporting and executive reviews that keep leadership decision-ready. Operational Optimization Drive the optimization agenda across the network: rider economics and staffing efficiency, vendor and coverage performance, area-level improvements. Find where the operation leaks cost or time, size the opportunity, and lead the fix, balancing efficiency against rider earnings and customer experience. Data, Modeling & Insight Be genuinely good with data, able to interrogate complex models, understand what's driving them, and pressure-test assumptions rather than take outputs at face value. Build the analyses and dashboards that make decisions faster, and translate complexity into a clear "so what." SQL (BigQuery) and Looker/Tableau are a strong plus; the non-negotiable is analytical judgment. Strategic Projects & Senior Stakeholder Leadership Lead cross-functional, high-impact projects that shape UAE operations. Build the business case, run the pilot, scale what works. Throughout, work directly with senior leadership, and hold your own with directors and VPs, defending a recommendation with evidence and staying credible under challenge. What you own vs. influence: You own the operational commercials, the performance KPI stack, and the delivery of your optimization projects. You influence the ops, commercial, and product teams whose execution moves those numbers, through insight, credibility, and stakeholder trust rather than direct authority. Qualifications What did we order? At least 4 years in operations, commercial, strategy, or consulting, ideally in a marketplace, logistics, or Q-commerce environment. Commercial instinct: you understand how a business makes money and which levers actually move it. Strong data literacy, comfortable working with complex data and models, interrogating assumptions, and drawing the right conclusion. You don't need to be handed the answer. Executive presence: able to engage, challenge, and stand your ground with senior stakeholders including directors and VPs. Financial modeling and P&L fluency, you can read a model, break it, and explain it. SQL (BigQuery) and Looker/Tableau a strong plus, not a requirement. Bias for ownership and follow-through, you close the loop rather than hand off the problem. Readiness to grow into people leadership (1–2 reports over time).

results.title: Airfreight Manager
results.location: Sharjah, Sharjah Emirate, United Arab Emirates
results.description: About the Role The Air Freight Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management of the airfreight function, including product development, commercial performance, and operational execution. This role drives the growth and profitability of the airfreight business while ensuring seamless shipment handling, strong carrier partnerships, and high service standards. Responsibilities Product & Strategy Develop and execute the airfreight strategy aligned with overall freight forwarding objectives. Build competitive service offerings across key trade lanes and industry verticals. Identify and develop specialized services (e.g., pharma, perishables, e-commerce, DG). Monitor market trends, rates, and capacity to proactively adjust strategy. Operational Management Lead and manage the Airfreight Import & Export teams. Ensure smooth end-to-end shipment execution in line with SOPs and service standards. Drive operational efficiency, productivity, and quality performance. Manage escalations and implement corrective actions where required. Carrier & Supplier Management Develop and maintain strong relationships with airlines, GSAs, and partners. Negotiate competitive rates, contracts, and capacity agreements. Secure space allocation, especially during peak seasons. Monitor carrier performance and ensure service reliability. Commercial & Financial Performance Own airfreight P&L, including revenue, GP, and cost control. Develop pricing strategies and maintain rate structures. Support RFQs, tenders, and key customer solutions. Drive yield improvement and profitability across shipments. Sales Support & Business Growth Partner with sales teams to grow volumes and strategic accounts. Provide pricing guidance, market insights, and solution design. Support customer acquisition and retention efforts. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with Ocean Freight and Customs Brokerage teams to ensure integrated service delivery. Ensure alignment across departments for seamless customer experience. Contribute to overall freight forwarding performance and growth. Performance & Reporting Monitor OKRs including volume, revenue, margins, and service levels. Provide regular reports and forecasts to the Head of Freight Forwarding. Analyze trade lane performance and drive continuous improvement. Qualifications 6–10 years of experience in airfreight within a freight forwarding environment. Proven experience handling both operations and commercial/product responsibilities. Strong background in airline negotiations, pricing, and trade lane management. Experience managing airfreight import/export teams. Required Skills Strong leadership and team management skills. Commercial acumen with P&L ownership mindset. Excellent negotiation and stakeholder management capability. Deep understanding of airfreight operations and global market dynamics. Ability to balance operational execution with strategic growth. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Preferred Skills IATA certification. Experience in the Middle East market. Exposure to specialized cargo segments.
